texts.text: I was about to spend £400 on a new dining table set...

scene.environment: Real home dining nook/kitchen area with grey marble-effect tiled floor, a compact grey dining table and chairs, white walls, patio doors opening to a suburban garden, wall-mounted abstract black acoustic/art panels, a potted plant, and a warm floor/lamp glow in the corner.
scene.lighting: Mixed natural and warm ambient lighting: bright daylight enters through the patio doors on the right, while a warm amber lamp glow adds coziness on the left-center wall. Overall lighting is naturalistic with visible reflections on the glossy floor.
scene.concept: UGC-style interior/home improvement creative with a candid, relatable smartphone aesthetic; modern grey home decor, natural lighting, and an informal social media caption overlay. ; Capture attention at the start of a conversion-oriented or educational creative by framing a high-cost problem and teasing a cheaper alternative, encouraging viewers to keep watching and consider the advertised solution.
